title: Silas Newton speech: beings interested in atomic research

tellings.quote: Unquestionably, they are interested in our atomic research.

plain: In a speech given in 1950, a man named Silas Newton said that visiting beings were taking a close interest in America's nuclear work: "Unquestionably, they are interested in our atomic research." His words come up in an episode about a reported crash of a craft with alien bodies on board. If he was right, it would mean beings from elsewhere were watching the atomic programme.
